column4: Clears a 12-byte owned buffer: if byte [+8] is set, calls CRT::_delete on [+0], then zeroes [+0], [+4], [+8]. RTTI-proven CCFileClass destructor calls it with ecx=this+0x58 and BufferStraw/BufferPipe RTTI destructors with ecx=this+0xC; YRpp MemoryBuffer has the same field layout and Clear() semantics. Three-byte RGB constructor: writes stack args to [this+0..+2] in R,G,B order, ret 0xC, returns this in eax. Called by on-disk [已证] RulesClass::Read_File with 0,0,0 and by LoadProgressManager::Draw/palette paths; YRpp declares ColorStruct(BYTE,BYTE,BYTE) with BYTE R,G,B.
